[NERR.11.1] Raised when artefacts that must agree do not (e.g. a `.dsc` and a
separately-built binding tuple disagree on hash or dialect). Rebuild all
artefacts from one consistent source.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_BND_DSC_MISMATCH`     | `dsc_sha256` disagrees between artefacts |
| `DS_ERR_BND_DIALECT_MISMATCH` | resolved settings or their hash disagree ([NDLC.4.5]), or the admission policy does not admit a setting ([NLFC.10.2]) |
| `DS_ERR_BND_INCOMPLETE`       | a required tuple field is missing / zero-length |

-704 is realtime's ([NERR.18]). -702 is reserved and never reused ([STYL.2.8.7]): an artefact carries no format
version to disagree on ([LDET.1.10]).
